question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**kindest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The passage contrasts outward appearance with true character.
 
• It highlights that people with rough exteriors can actually be the most considerate individuals.
 
• "**Kindest**" fits the context perfectly as it positively contrasts with the idea of rough exteriors.
 
• Other options ("**bitterest**", "**strangest**", "**gloomiest**") have negative or irrelevant connotations that do not fit the context of describing someone who is truly considerate and kind.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**kindest**'.

 

Complete Passage: * Appearances may not reveal the man. So, you shouldn't make judgments about a man's character based on how he looks__. People smile and smile, yet prove to be __deceitful__. On the other hand, people with rough exteriors prove to be the __kindest__ and most considerate people on earth. They are the people who are beautiful from __within__. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** __Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Bitterest (कड़वा): Indicates the most intense sharpness, which does not fit the context here.
 
• Strangest (अजीब): Indicates the most unusual, which is irrelevant.
 
• Gloomiest (उदास): Indicates the most depressing, which does not fit the context here.
